An eye button on the cover that hides covers (only their colours show) or shows them again
Normal or glass bars and cards, with a live preview
Glass shows what is behind the bars, the floating buttons, menus, dialogs and Home\'s Glass cards, blurred. Changes glide in; rows like these take the glass look the next time a page opens.
This Android version can\'t blur in real time (that needs Android 12): glass shows as a tinted, see-through surface instead.
Tuned: the values below differ from the style\'s own. Tap the style again to go back to them.
How soft what is behind the glass looks
How much of the bar\'s own colour is over the glass; more is easier to read
Colours behind the glass, from faded to vivid (100% as they are)
A faint texture, as frosted glass has
A thin bright edge along the top, like light on glass
The tool bar, the navigation bar, the control panel and the floating buttons. Over the YouTube and browser pages and over fullscreen video they are tinted glass without the blur.
Long-press menus, dialogs and cards such as the playlist picker and All in One
Lower draws the blur smaller and stretches it; it looks the same and costs much less. The power saver always uses Battery.
Widgets with the Glass look (Settings > Home > Widget look) blur the Home background behind them
